activity_summary: At the inn in Chipping Norton the supper and the shared bed were fourteen pence. The host said the dog had the stool. Hobbins told you to let the dog keep it. You did not praise the bed, and you did not add a speech about the twenty-one miles. The price did not grow while you stood in the yard.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted fourteen pence, and refused to praise the bed in advance.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Named the twenty-one miles, and gave the stool to the dog.

facets.activity: Took the fourteen pence and let the dog keep the stool

quotes.speaker: (the host)
quotes.text: Supper and a bed. Fourteen pence.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Fourteen pence. I'll see the bed when I've eaten
